titleEn: Minimum Cost Homecoming of a Robot in a Grid
title: 网格图中机器人回家的最小代价
summary: 机器人从起点沿四方向回家，进入某行或列分别付对应代价，求最小总代价。
insight: 任何绕路都会额外进入行列并产生非负费用，最优路径在行和列方向各单调走到目标。每进入一条新行或列累加其成本，行列移动顺序不影响总和。
pitfalls: 目标行列要付进入费用
可先走行或列，代价相同

solutions.title: 行列单调移动费用
solutions.idea: 分别沿两个坐标方向累加入境成本。
steps: row 从 startRow 向 homeRow 每步移动并加 rowCosts[newRow]

code.java: class Solution { public int minCost(int[] startPos,int[] homePos,int[] rowCosts,int[] colCosts){int answer=0,row=startPos[0],col=startPos[1];while(row!=homePos[0]){row+=row<homePos[0]?1:-1;answer+=rowCosts[row];}while(col!=homePos[1]){col+=col<homePos[1]?1:-1;answer+=colCosts[col];}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minCost(startPos:IntArray,homePos:IntArray,rowCosts:IntArray,colCosts:IntArray):Int{var answer=0;var row=startPos[0];var col=startPos[1];while(row!=homePos[0]){row+=if(row<homePos[0])1 else -1;answer+=rowCosts[row]};while(col!=homePos[1]){col+=if(col<homePos[1])1 else -1;answer+=colCosts[col]};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minCost(vector<int>& startPos,vector<int>& homePos,vector<int>& rowCosts,vector<int>& colCosts){int answer=0,row=startPos[0],col=startPos[1];while(row!=homePos[0]){row+=row<homePos[0]?1:-1;answer+=rowCosts[row];}while(col!=homePos[1]){col+=col<homePos[1]?1:-1;answer+=colCosts[col];}return answer;} };
